verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right: logo, suitcase, then the headline, subhead and CTA stacked as one block. Its flaws are a small headline for the format, a tiny CTA, and a block of legal text that is illegible at this size and pressed against the right edge. B makes the headline huge but shrinks the logo to near-illegible and jams it against the headline. It also squeezes the subhead into four ragged lines ending in an orphaned 'payments.', and crowds the CTA and dense legal block into the right side, so it looks overstuffed with no breathing room.
